title: What is the average total quantity across all final packaging combinations,
question: What is the average total quantity across all final packaging combinations, considering only the leaf-level items within each combination after fully expanding any nested packaging relationships?

prediction.sql:
WITH RECURSIVE
roots AS (
  SELECT p.id
  FROM packaging p
  WHERE NOT EXISTS (
    SELECT 1
    FROM packaging_relations pr
    WHERE pr.packaging_id = p.id
  )
),
exp(root_id, leaf_id, qty) AS (
  SELECT r.id, r.id, 1
  FROM roots r
  UNION ALL
  SELECT e.root_id, pr.contains_id, e.qty * pr.qty
  FROM exp e
  JOIN packaging_relations pr ON pr.packaging_id = e.leaf_id
)
SELECT AVG(total_qty) AS avg_total_quantity
FROM (
  SELECT root_id, SUM(qty) AS total_qty
  FROM exp
  GROUP BY root_id
);

persistent_recovery_advisory_draft.base_sql:
WITH RECURSIVE
top AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT packaging_id AS id FROM packaging_relations
  EXCEPT
  SELECT DISTINCT contains_id FROM packaging_relations
),
exp(root, leaf, qty) AS (
  SELECT t.id, r.contains_id, r.qty
  FROM top t JOIN packaging_relations r ON r.packaging_id = t.id
  UNION ALL
  SELECT e.root, r.contains_id, e.qty * r.qty
  FROM exp e JOIN packaging_relations r ON r.packaging_id = e.leaf
),
totals AS (
  SELECT root, SUM(qty) AS total_qty
  FROM exp
  GROUP BY root
)
SELECT AVG(total_qty) AS avg_total_quantity
FROM totals;
